name: Resurrection Of Christ
overview: The Resurrection of Christ is the foundational truth that Jesus was raised from the dead by the glory of the Father, confirming His victory over death and His role as the appointed judge of the world. Scripture reveals that Jesus Himself declared He is the resurrection and the life, promising eternal life to all who believe in Him. This resurrection power not only assures Christ's exaltation at God's right hand but also enables believers to walk in newness of life and receive the Spirit that will quicken their mortal bodies. Thus, the resurrection is both the guarantee of our justification and the source of our ongoing spiritual vitality.
